findings.title: Reject embedded NULs before publishing client text
findings.message: UpdateClient passes arbitrary Go text through a NUL-terminated C string without rejecting embedded NULs. For example, "A\x00B" reaches the native implementation as "A", so a successful binding can silently publish different text and invalidate subsequent BeforeText provenance checks. Native validation cannot detect the discarded suffix.
findings.suggestion: Reject embedded NULs and invalid UTF-8 before calling C.CString, consistent with Decode and the geometry publication path. Return false without modifying native state for unrepresentable text.

findings.title: Validate client offsets before narrowing to C.int
findings.message: UpdateClient narrows Go int offsets to 32-bit C.int without checking their range. On 64-bit Darwin, an invalid offset such as 1<<32 becomes zero, allowing native range validation to accept a different selection instead of rejecting the supplied value. UpdateGeometryForClient already guards against this conversion.
findings.suggestion: Apply the same [-1, 1<<31-1] offset checks used by UpdateGeometryForClient before converting anchor, focus, markedStart, and markedEnd to C.int; return false on failure.
findings.evidence: return bool(C.vellum_input_client_update(i.native, C.uint64_t(clientID), p, C.int(anchor), C.int(focus), C.int(markedStart), C.int(markedEnd), C.bool(active), C.uint64_t(ack), C.double(rect[0]), C.double(rect[1]), C.double(rect[2]), C.double(rect[3])))
